comments:
First of three texts in an 88-folio manuscript with continuous folio numbering, listed as a single item in [8H6M69W4], No. 15415. 
Title reported in [8H6M69W4], No. 15415: dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi 'grel ba bzhugs |. However, the title on the cover page reads: zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i dbu ma'i 'grel; underneath is the annotation: 'di slob dpon zla grags kyis mdzad pa min par pa tshab lo tsas mdzad pa yin 'dug. See <<Dreyfus and Tsering 2009 [FFQQBB4J]>>.

Diplomatic edition of fols. 30a1-37b11 in [RZ74ZGVR].

item_description:
See [FFQQBB4J].
Script: 'bru tsha.
The text is divided into two columns rather than written in a single line.
Orthography:
- Palatalization of ma (e.g., myi, myed)
- Alternative prefixes (e.g., rngos for dngos, rgos for dgos)
Use of expressions mirroring the Sanskrit (e.g., buta for buddha, bode for bodhi(sattva)
